text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Good work. Right now, I am offering 
detailed explanations of "Yukoma Onsen 
Village" to anyone interested—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: <username>, do you need an explanation?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what would you like me to 
explain?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of what you'd like to ask about 
training for the "Yukoma Hot Spring 
Resort"—
choice_data_list: About revitalizing the hot spring town

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You want to know about "Revitalizing the 
Hot Spring Resort", right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To revitalize the hot spring village, 
everyone will be tasked with excavating 
the hot spring source.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
As you dig further, the inn's rank will 
increase! The inn's rank rises depending 
on the number of hot springs fully 
excavated.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
We can also get Ryokan Rank Bonuses, so 
let's use those as a guide for our 
excavation!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Also, to reward the Umamusume, we have 
scheduled 3 'Hot Springs Gatherings'♪ A 
higher Inn Rank seems to boost their 
satisfaction!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To earn a higher Ryokan Rank, let's 
excavate efficiently and increase the 
number of hot spring sources!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
By the way, you'll be participating in 
these activities alongside the Twinkle 
Series. Please do your best with your 
daily training too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please note that depending on training 
conditions, your training may conclude 
even while participating in the Hot 
Springs Resort Revitalization, so please 
be careful.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation for 
"Revitalizing the Hot Spring Resort". Is 
there anything else you'd like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You want to know about "Hot Spring Source 
Selection", right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Before proceeding with excavation, please 
select the target hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hot springs are composed of three types of 
strata: "Sand," "Soil," and "Rock." You 
will excavate them using drilling 
equipment corresponding to each stratum.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The combination and thickness of the 
strata vary depending on the hot spring's 
source.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"And when selecting a spring source, you 
can level up one piece of excavation 
equipment to boost excavation efficiency!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hot springs offer various beneficial 
effects. When a trainee Umamusume bathes, 
"Hot Spring Power" will grant helpful 
buffs for training!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Be sure to check carefully before making a 
choice. Think about the effects you want, 
and choose which springs to excavate!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation for "Hot 
Spring Source Selection". Is there 
anything else you'd like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You'd like to know about "Excavation," 
then.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Excavation will automatically progress 
when you choose "Training," "Rest," "Go 
Out," or "Enter a Race."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In the case of Training, the excavation 
yield varies based on the "number of 
Support Cards training together."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Also, the amount excavated is heavily 
influenced by a bonus called Excavation 
Power!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Excavation power for each stratum is 
determined by the 'Trained Umamusume's 
Base Stats', 'Excavation Equipment Level', 
and 'Base Stat Factors'.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can acquire basic stats depending on 
your excavation progress, so let's keep 
digging away♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
However, excavating consumes Energy. When 
training, please be mindful of your 
remaining Energy as well.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation for 
"Excavation." Is there anything else you'd 
like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You want to know about "Hot Spring Power", 
right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Using a Bath Ticket to soak in the hot 
springs allows you to activate Hot Spring 
Power.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Activating Hot Spring Power grants 
advantageous effects for training and 
recovers your energy! Let's refresh 
ourselves at the hot springs and do our 
best♪"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Moreover, consuming a large amount of 
Energy might trigger 'Ultra Recovery'...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
With "Super Recovery," energy can exceed 
the maximum limit, and your stats will 
increase as well! Be proactive about 
spending your energy!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"The effects of Hot Spring Power will be 
enhanced with additional benefits from the 
spring sources once excavation is 
completed♪"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can sometimes obtain Bath Tickets 
through "PR Activities" or various events!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"PR Activities" is a command to promote 
the hot spring town. You can earn 1 Bath 
Ticket each time you perform it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation for "Hot 
Spring Power". Is there anything else 
you'd like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Are you truly all right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood♪ Just to be sure, I have a 
brief summary right here.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can review that explanation at any 
time by tapping the 'i' button in the top 
left.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, best of luck. I'll be cheering 
you on quietly.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In that case, do your best, 
okay? I'll be quietly cheering you on.
